errors.description: scrub_status_q is a multi-bit value produced in mem_clk and sampled directly in ctrl_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
done_pulse_q is a one-cycle mem_clk pulse consumed directly in ctrl_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample ctrl_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in ctrl_event_o.
scrub_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector scrub_mode_q before decoding in ctrl_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
mem_rst_n is used as data inside ctrl_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
diag_snapshot_q combines mem_clk payload state with ctrl_clk status state in diag_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
